title: Suspect Gets Hit by His Own Car While Fleeing Police
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch - Use 'BLUE20' for 20% off!
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 29, 2023, dispatch received a report about a vehicle evading a traffic stop in Winnebago County, WI. Despite efforts to stop him, the suspect fled erratically at speeds over 100 mph. During the pursuit, he abandoned the vehicle, which rolled down a ditch and collided with him, briefly causing loss of balance. Later, it was revealed that he also had 8 active warrants for his arrest from multiple agencies.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
